news.headline: A Spacecraft Reaches a Brand-New Asteroid Neighborhood
news.body: NASA's Lucy spacecraft has traveled more than 2.2 billion miles since it blasted off in 2021. Now it is the first spacecraft ever to enter the area of the Jupiter Trojan asteroids, where thousands of space rocks travel around the Sun along the same path as the giant planet Jupiter. Lucy will zoom past its first Trojan asteroid, called Eurybates, on August 11, 2027. Scientists hope these old rocks will help explain how the planets formed long, long ago.

news.headline: A Baby Panda Gets Ready to Meet Visitors
news.body: A giant panda cub named Shu Bao will meet visitors for the first time this Friday at Everland, a theme park in South Korea. She was born on June 3 and weighed only about 6 ounces, as light as an apple! Now she weighs more than 20 pounds. Her keepers say she toddles around, plays with her mom, and practices climbing trees. Her name means "a treasure as bright as the light of dawn," and it was picked from about 220,000 votes.

news.headline: A Gymnast Balances on His Knuckles for a World Record
news.body: Madden Shelley from Tennessee fell in love with gymnastics at a friend's birthday party when he was a kid. Now he holds a Guinness World Records title! He did a handstand balancing on his knuckles instead of his flat hands and held it for 1 minute and 23 seconds. He trained carefully for months to get strong enough, so this is not a trick to try at home. Next, he hopes to go after another handstand record.

fun_fact: A newborn giant panda is pink, nearly hairless, and about the size of a stick of butter. Its mom is about 900 times heavier! 🐼

this_day_in_history: On October 29, 1998, John Glenn blasted off on the space shuttle Discovery at age 77, becoming the oldest person to fly in space at that time! 🚀
did_you_know: The Lucy spacecraft is named after a famous fossil called Lucy, and that fossil got its name from a Beatles song, "Lucy in the Sky with Diamonds." 🎶
